name: Reservoir Light Replay Backpropagation
definition: A constant-memory reverse-mode differentiable light tracing method that compresses the set of per-path sensor connections into a single stochastically selected representative using weighted reservoir sampling, preserving a two-pass structure at the cost of increased gradient variance.
summary: ResLRB is a constant-memory differentiable light tracing method that compresses per-path connections into a single representative via weighted reservoir sampling, trading gradient fidelity for bounded memory.
